name: Communication (PMn)

rules.name: Program Requirements

children.name: 20 units of graduate courses in Communication
Three theory or research methods courses, determined with a department advisor
Examination by a representative of the department

rules.desc: Candidates for the PhD degree in other departments who elect a minor in Communication must complete a minimum of 20 units of graduate courses in the Department of Communication, including three theory or research methods courses. A representative of the department examines them. In consultation with the individual student, a department advisor determines the particular communication theory and methods courses.

transferPolicy: Per policy (GAP 4.5.1 Doctoral Degrees, Requirements), all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks at least 20 units of graduate courses in Communication (COMM). Three of them must be theory or research methods courses that a department advisor picks with you, and a representative of the department examines you; you check both by hand. All of the coursework must be taken at Stanford.
